dialogues.speaker: Bracari
dialogues.text: I'm an old acquaintance of her father. Got a hand in her marksmanship, too, if I do say so myself.

dialogues.speaker: Bracari
dialogues.text: Of course, she didn't learn it here. This place is too small — any drawing of weapons isn't going to end well for anyone.

dialogues.speaker: Bracari
dialogues.text: If someone does dare cause trouble here, they will be sent away to start a new life in the ocean.
